name: Labor of Love
source:
Your usual shift involves taking orders, pouring coffee, and making rent on tips. Then Jules Hayworth walks into your diner - and suddenly, a billionaire’s future comes with a job offer you never saw coming.

Jules needs an heir before turning thirty-five, and you’re being offered the chance to carry the baby. The arrangement comes with a contract, clear boundaries, and one very inconvenient complication: your attraction to the person you’re supposed to keep at arm’s length. You can agree to keep things professional. Getting your heart to cooperate might be harder.
